summary: Bounce light: screen-space GI that lets sunlit walls, paving and roofs light what faces them in their colours.
stage: game capture at 1600x900, --offscreen --perf=0 --nohud: --host --team=0 --seed=3 --preset=high --mood=golden with FL_DEBUG_GI_CYCLE (frozen frame, each GI mode in turn) and FL_DEBUG_GI_POSES='street:town:32:-28:0.6;ruin:ruin:16:-58:0.4;alley:alley:16:-42:0', composed as off | High | (High - off) x4 panels; pan clip: --fixed-fps 30 with FL_DEBUG_GI_PAN=0,-20,75 FL_DEBUG_GI_MODES=view_added FL_DEBUG_GI_POSES=p:town:30:-35:1.57 (the added light alone, gamma-brightened)
rationale: The change is a lighting difference on the same frame, so matched panels of one frozen frame with bounce light off and on, plus their amplified difference, show both how it looks and where the light lands, in the three places it matters (street, a ruin's interior, between houses). Its stability while the camera pans is the motion question, answered by a short clip of the added light alone during a fast pan. Cost is measured in the pull request.
